node.title: XR rank-two shells obey an exact arity and Maxwell-deficit router
node.statement: For every uniform high-core rank-two trade with |X|=a+d+1, its pairwise-disjoint row-zero fibers have sizes 1<=z_i<=d, satisfy z_i+z_j>=d+1, and obey an exact parity-sensitive minimum-mass bound and active-row ceiling. Extending the active supports to their selected blocks gives the explicit Maxwell deficit lower bound Delta_J>=2(d+1)+t(h-2d-2)+(d+1)t(t-1)-2(t-2)Z. Positivity excludes a relation supported on every block of its minimal Maxwell core. This removes primitive full-core rank two on very large first- and second-shell prize-rank intervals and gives an exact router on every shell; proper local circuits and their aggregate ownership remain open.
